title: Turning into a social media site…
content:
This update completely ruined the Suno app for me.

I pay a premium monthly price because I use Suno as a WORK TOOL. I am creating, remixing, testing versions, comparing generations, and trying to get actual work done. I am not opening Suno because I want a social-media-style discovery feed pushed into my workflow.

Before this update, I could create a song, generate more versions, and continue working through those generations in a logical, continuous flow. Now Suno gives me the two songs I generated and then immediately fills the rest of the screen with recommended songs from other people.

I have absolutely no interest in that.

I am not there to browse other creators. I am not there to discover music. I am not there to scroll through recommendations. I am there to work on MY OWN MUSIC.

Even worse, when I generate additional versions of my own song, those new generations are no longer presented together in the same clean workflow. I have to open another section just to find the two new songs I just created, while unrelated recommended music is taking up space in the main feed.

How is that an improvement?

You took something that felt like a useful creative production workspace and turned it into another social media experience.

If people want recommendations and discovery, that is perfectly fine. Give them a Discover tab. Give them a toggle. Give them an option.

But do not force it into the creation workflow of paying subscribers.

I am paying every month to CREATE MUSIC, not to have other people’s music placed in front of me while I am trying to work.

This update made the app more cluttered, more frustrating, and less useful for serious creation.

Please give users an option to COMPLETELY DISABLE RECOMMENDED SONGS and restore the continuous generation workflow so all versions of the same creation stay together.

Not every app needs to become social media.

Hello Suno team,

I’ve happily paid for my subscription over the past several months. The previous models allowed me to create music with beautiful melodies, a style I truly enjoyed, and a sound that conveyed genuine emotion.

However, now that model 6 is the only option available in my account, my experience has changed. The sound feels overly synthetic to me, and I feel it has lost the warmth, musicality, and melodic sensitivity I valued so much.

Please consider allowing subscribers to choose the previous models again. Having access to them would be a reason for me to keep my subscription.

Unfortunately, if this new model remains the only option, I’ll have to cancel because I no longer feel I can get the same value from the service. That’s disappointing, because I truly enjoyed creating music with Suno.

Thank you for your time and consideration. I hope you’ll take this feedback into account.

title: System Failure
content:
The AI consistently fails to follow clear and specific instructions. I explicitly tell it not to change, remove, duplicate, or add lyrics, yet it continues to alter the structure, repeat lyrics, and unnecessarily extend songs to five minutes or longer.

I also give clear instructions for a short musical opening and a natural ending, but the system often creates long instrumental sections or ends the song incorrectly, sometimes before the vocals are even completed.

I have had to regenerate the same song multiple times just to try to get the AI to follow basic directions, wasting both time and generations. Even after simplifying the instructions, the same problems continue.

For a paid AI music service, users should be able to expect the system to respect their lyrics, requested structure, and basic production instructions. The music can sound beautiful, but that becomes irrelevant when the AI repeatedly ignores the user’s directions and cannot reliably complete the song as requested.

The AI instruction-following and song-length control need significant improvement.

I’m an underground techno DJ and even though the quality of the songs is amazing, no matter what reference sound you upload when creating your song, the algorithm somehow starts the song similar to the reference sound but always mid song through the end it ends up sounding like trance music, no matter how I write the prompt or no matter what audio reference I upload, the app always ends up switching to trance genre, could you guys please fix this or add like modules we can pick to be able to make the engine switch to techno, tech house, only and not mixing genres in the same song, other than that, it’s been pretty fun and I have made already a couple of decent songs, thanks!
